## Title

## Caption (Instagram)

## YouTube Shorts

**Title:** How to tell if a free tool is actually free

**Description:**

```
Free isn't a price, it's a transfer. Attention, data, later, or somebody else. Ask 'if I never pay, who is?' before you sign up — then tell me which one you were today.

Sources:
- Free products are commonly funded by advertising, by data, by upgrades, or by a non-commercial sponsor. (Open Source Definition (Open Source Initiative)) https://opensource.org/osd checked 2026-10-28
- Open source means a licence that allows use, study, modification and redistribution. (Open Source Definition (Open Source Initiative)) https://opensource.org/osd checked 2026-10-28
- You can usually identify how a free service is funded before you sign up, from its pricing page or licence. (Open Source Definition (Open Source Initiative)) https://opensource.org/osd checked 2026-10-28
```
